data.name: Ahyas
data.gender_notes: Ahyas is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root haya, meaning 'to live'. In Islamic tradition, Ahyas represents the breath of life that Allah (swt) bestows upon us. The name Ahyas carries the meaning “Breath or Life” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahyas usually hope their child will grow to embody breath or life and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual connection between Allah (swt) and His creation.
data.etymology: Ahyas belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breath or Life.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahyas total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أحياس
in_arabic.meaning: أحيا ساعة، فترة زمنيّة، أو أَحيا الحدّث، المَجد
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُعتبر أَحياً ساعةً أو فترةً زمنيّةً، وَهو إحدى الأسماء القديمة التي تعني المجد والفخر، ويُرجع أصلها إلى الجذر الحَقيق الأَرَبِي. في الإسلام، يُعد أَحياً من أشهر الأسماء التي يُعتبرها المسلمون اسمًا فخارًا، ويُستخدم لِلمولود الذكر، ويُرمز لِلمجد والفخر والقوة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم أَحياً للدلالة على المجد والفخر، وَالأَحيا هو اسم فاعل يُشير إلى المجد الحاصل، وَهو من أهم الأسماء التي تُعبر عن المجد والفخر في الإسلام.

Ahyas is also a name that is associated with the concept of resurrection, and is often used in Islamic prayers and invocations. Overall, Ahyas is a name that is steeped in Islamic tradition and heritage, and is considered a beautiful and meaningful name for any child.
